language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the interface.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Pick the theme that matches your environment.

header.description: Advanced controls for the search to download to import pipeline. Defaults are tuned to a balanced sweet spot that works well for most setups, change them only if you know what you are doing. When in doubt, leave them as-is or hit Reset to defaults on the affected card if tracks start failing after a change.

maxPeerAttempts.label: Max peer attempts
maxPeerAttempts.description: How many slskd uploaders to try downloading from per track before marking it failed.

maxVariations.label: Max variations
maxVariations.description: How many query-string combinations (artist+title, with/without album, with/without featuring) to try per track.

historyCleanup.label: History cleanup enabled
historyCleanup.description: Hourly cron deletes old slskd searches so its search list does not grow unbounded.

maxHistorySearches.label: Max history searches
maxHistorySearches.description: How many of the most recent searches to retain in slskd. Older ones are removed by the cleanup job above.

autoBan.label: Auto-ban after N failures
autoBan.description: Add an uploader/peer to the banlist after this many download failures (counted in-memory, resets on restart). 0 disables.

strictTierOrdering.label: Strict quality tier ordering
strictTierOrdering.description: Always try lossless sources first, then high-bitrate lossy, then the rest. Within each tier the usual blended score still decides the order.

customMoodKeywords.label: Custom mood keywords
customMoodKeywords.helper: Substrings tested against user search queries to classify them as mood/genre searches (vs specific artist/track). Press Enter or comma to add.

searchPhase.label: Search phase
searchPhase.description: How long slskd keeps each search request open on the Soulseek network before stopping collection of new results.

downloadPhase.label: Download phase
downloadPhase.description: Total budget for the full download phase per track. The track is marked failed if this elapses. Usenet and torrent albums are fetched before this starts, under their own limits.

importPhase.label: Import phase
importPhase.description: Total budget for the import phase per track. Marked failed if exceeded.

peerUnresponsive.label: Peer unresponsive
peerUnresponsive.description: Max time a download can sit in slskd's unresponsive states before we cancel and try the next peer.

queueWaitActivePeer.label: Queue wait (active peer)
queueWaitActivePeer.description: Max wait in slskd's Queued states when the peer is already actively serving another download to us (likely to give this one its turn).

queueWaitIdlePeer.label: Queue wait (idle peer)
queueWaitIdlePeer.description: Max wait in slskd's queued states when the peer is not currently serving us anything (may be offline or ignoring the request).

maxSize.label: Max size
maxSize.description: Hard cap on total jobs the queue holds at once (queued + active). New requests are rejected when full.

maxConcurrentSearches.label: Max concurrent searches
maxConcurrentSearches.description: How many tracks can be in the search phase simultaneously.

maxPendingImports.label: Max pending imports
maxPendingImports.description: Backpressure: when this many downloaded tracks are waiting to import, the engine pauses starting new searches until imports drain.

metadataConfidence.label: Metadata confidence threshold
metadataConfidence.description: Minimum match (0-100) between a downloaded file's embedded audio tags. Files below this score are rejected with and can be retried.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.description: Files that failed verification are remembered here, so a retry never downloads the same wrong file from the same source again.

identityGate.label: AcoustID identity gate
identityGate.description: Block the import when the audio fingerprint identifies a different song than the requested one. The file is quarantined and a retry looks for another candidate.

empty.title: No quarantined files
empty.description: When a downloaded file fails verification, the exact file and its source appear here and are skipped on retries.

confirmClear.title: Clear the quarantine?
confirmClear.message: All entries will be removed. Retries may download these exact files from the same sources again.

sourceTrust.title: Source trust
sourceTrust.manage: Banned uploaders and the auto-ban threshold are managed in the <slskd>Soulseek settings</slskd>.

autoBan.label: Auto-ban threshold
autoBan.description: Failed downloads before an uploader is banned automatically.

reviewQueue.hint: A rejected file is kept for you to judge. Open the <review>review queue</review> in Requests to approve or discard it.

wanted.title: Wanted sweep
wanted.description: Watches failed tracks and retries them periodically, spaced out by release age.

enabled.label: Enable wanted sweep
enabled.description: Periodically retry failed tracks that are being watched.

perRunCap.label: Tracks per sweep
perRunCap.description: Maximum number of watched tracks retried on each sweep run.

maxAttempts.label: Max sweep attempts
maxAttempts.description: Stop watching a track after this many unsuccessful sweep retries.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Upgrade already-downloaded tracks in place when you explicitly request a better copy.

upgradeEnabled.label: Allow quality upgrades
upgradeEnabled.description: An explicit re-request can replace an owned file when the new copy is strictly better.

retentionDays.label: Retention period
retentionDays.description: How many days replaced files stay in the recycle bin before cleanup.

status.loadError: Failed to load recycle bin status

size.label: Total size
size.description: Disk space currently used by the recycle bin.

entries.label: Files
entries.description: Replaced files currently kept in the recycle bin.

oldest.label: Oldest entry
oldest.description: Date of the oldest recycled file.

empty.confirmMessage: All replaced files kept in the recycle bin will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

list.toggle_one: Show the one file it holds
list.noMatches: No file in the bin matches that

check.label: Look for files whose track is gone
check.description: Lyrics and per-track artwork stay on disk when the music they belonged to is removed. Checking reads your whole library, so it is not done automatically.

found.label: Files found
found.description: Each one belongs to a track that is no longer there.

size.label: Space they take
size.description: What you get back by moving them to the recycle bin.

unreadable.label: Folders that could not be read
unreadable.description: Nothing in these was counted, so a disk that is not mounted never looks like missing music.

sweep.action: Move them to the recycle bin
sweep.confirmTitle: Move these files to the recycle bin?
sweep.confirmMessage: {{count}} file(s) will be moved to the recycle bin, where you can restore them until the retention window passes. Nothing is deleted now.

enrichment.title: Metadata Enrichment
enrichment.description: External services that enrich your library with artwork, fingerprinting fallbacks, and tagging data. All optional but recommended, leave empty to fall back to public defaults or skip the feature.

musicbrainzEmail.label: MusicBrainz contact email
musicbrainzEmail.helper: Required. Without it, Synthseek shares rate-limited email.

acoustidKey.label: AcoustID API key
acoustidKey.helper: Audio fingerprinting fallback for tracks without reliable tag metadata.

discogsToken.label: Discogs token (optional)
discogsToken.helper: Adds genres, labels and release details from Discogs. Leave blank to skip Discogs.

bandsintownAppId.label: Bandsintown app id (optional)
bandsintownAppId.helper: Fills the upcoming shows widget with concerts by your artists. Bandsintown gives one for free.

usernameAffix.label: Username affix

separator.label: Separator

bannedUploaders.tooltipWhat: Soulseek usernames added here are blocked as download sources. Synthseek skips their files and downloads from another source instead. Add anyone who keeps sending bad files or failing to deliver.
bannedUploaders.tooltipAuto: Synthseek can also add uploaders here for you. When a user's transfers fail too many times in a row they are banned automatically. Only real transfer failures count, not filename mismatches, and the limit is configured in Engine > Search (set it to 0 to turn auto-ban off).

mediaServers.panelLabel: Settings of the selected place to play from

local.description: Synthseek's own copy of each track. It always plays first, and the servers below are only tried when it cannot.
local.nothingToSet: Nothing to set up here. Library paths and naming live in Library.

lidarr.title: Lidarr
lidarr.description: Hand off albums to an existing Lidarr instance.

ytdlp.title: yt-dlp
ytdlp.description: Fallback source used when slskd cannot deliver a track. Format and quality follow each request's own config.

enable.label: Enable
enable.description: When on, tracks that fail on higher-priority sources are retried via yt-dlp within the same job.

searchResults.label: Search results
searchResults.description: How many YouTube candidates to fetch per track before scoring by duration and title.

maxDurationDelta.label: Max duration delta
maxDurationDelta.description: Reject candidates whose length differs from the expected track by more than this many seconds.

searchTimeout.label: Search timeout
searchTimeout.description: How long yt-dlp can spend searching YouTube for a track. YouTube search is slower than slskd, so it gets a wider default.

archive.title: Internet Archive
archive.description: Free music from the Internet Archive. Used when higher-priority sources cannot deliver a track.

enable.label: Enable
enable.description: When on, tracks the other sources cannot deliver are looked for in the collections below.

netlabels.label: Netlabel releases
netlabels.description: Albums independent labels published under free licences.

etree.label: Live recordings
etree.description: Concerts by bands that allow taping. Rarely the studio version of a track.

community.label: Community uploads
community.description: Music anyone uploaded, searched only when the collections above find nothing. Nobody checks the rights, and the licence is whatever the uploader claims.

archive.noCollection: Turn on at least one collection, or this source stays idle.

searchTimeout.label: Search timeout
searchTimeout.description: How long the Internet Archive can spend finding a track.

soundcloud.title: SoundCloud
soundcloud.description: Uploads on SoundCloud, downloaded through yt-dlp. Used when higher-priority sources cannot deliver a track.

enable.label: Enable
enable.description: When on, tracks the other sources cannot deliver are looked for on SoundCloud. Uploads named as remixes, covers or speed edits are skipped.

searchResults.label: Search results
searchResults.description: How many uploads to consider per track before choosing one.

maxDurationDelta.label: Max duration delta
maxDurationDelta.description: Reject uploads whose length differs from the expected track by more than this many seconds.

searchTimeout.label: Search timeout
searchTimeout.description: How long SoundCloud can spend finding a track.

torrent.title: Torrent
torrent.description: Downloads whole album releases from a Torznab indexer, such as Prowlarr or Jackett, through qBittorrent, and leaves them seeding.

enable.label: Enable
enable.description: When on, album requests can be served from torrents through your indexer and qBittorrent.

qbittorrentApiKey.label: qBittorrent API key
qbittorrentApiKey.hint: qBittorrent 5.2 or newer. Leave it empty to log in with a username and password.

category.label: Category
category.hint: Synthseek adds its torrents under this category. Its save folder must be the folder Synthseek reads as its downloads.

minSeeders.label: Minimum seeders
minSeeders.description: Skip releases with fewer seeders than this.

maxSize.label: Maximum release size
maxSize.description: Skip any release larger than this. Set to 0 to accept any size.

stallTimeout.label: Give up after
stallTimeout.description: A torrent that makes no progress for this long is left for the next source. Time spent queued in qBittorrent does not count.
stallTimeout.ariaLabel: Minutes without progress before giving up

queueTimeout.label: Wait in the queue for up to
queueTimeout.description: A torrent qBittorrent keeps queued longer than this is left for the next source.
queueTimeout.ariaLabel: Hours a torrent may wait in qBittorrent's queue

searchTimeout.label: Search timeout
searchTimeout.description: How long the indexer can spend finding a release.

singleTrackRequests.title: Single-track requests
singleTrackRequests.label: Use torrents outside albums too
singleTrackRequests.description: Off by default. When off, torrents are only offered for album requests.
singleTrackRequests.tooltipWhat: A torrent carries a whole release. Getting one song means downloading the album it belongs to.
singleTrackRequests.tooltipCost: Turning this on trades disk space and bandwidth for finding songs that nobody shares on their own.

stagingRetention.label: Keep finished torrents for
stagingRetention.description: How long a downloaded release waits for another of its tracks. After that it is deleted, but only once qBittorrent has stopped seeding it.
stagingRetention.ariaLabel: Hours a finished torrent is kept

test.ok: Connected to the indexer and qBittorrent

indexer.incomplete: Enter the indexer address and API key

warning.removes_on_share_limit: qBittorrent deletes torrents that reach their share limit, so a release can vanish before every track is taken from it.
warning.dht_off: DHT is off in qBittorrent, so magnet links cannot find their files.

windowDays.label: Window

userStorageGb.label: Storage per member

libraryStorageGb.label: Whole library
libraryStorageGb.description: A ceiling for the whole library. It applies to everyone, admins included, and counts files nobody requested.

mcp.title: AI assistants
mcp.description: Connect an AI assistant to Synthseek over the Model Context Protocol.
mcp.endpointHelper: Add this URL as a custom connector or MCP server in your assistant.
mcp.oauthBody: For claude.ai web and native connectors. Add the endpoint as a custom connector and sign in with your Synthseek account. No key needed, and access follows your role.
mcp.keyBody: For Claude Code, Cursor, or Claude Desktop (via mcp-remote). Create a key below and send it as the bearer token: Authorization: Bearer <your key>.
mcp.toolsDescription: What a connected assistant can do: search the catalog, queue and manage downloads, build playlists, browse your library, drive the music player, read and update settings, and (for admins) control the download queue, trigger jobs, check system health, and read server logs for diagnostics. Exact availability depends on your role.

tools.discovery: Discovery: search_music, get_music_details, get_artist_overview, get_artist_discography, get_trending, browse_genres, get_recommendations, resolve_url
tools.requests: Requests: list_requests, get_request, control_request, upgrade_tracks, get_my_quota, and (admin) decide_request
tools.playlists: Playlists: list_playlists, get_playlist, create_playlist, add_tracks_to_playlist, replace_playlist_tracks, remove_tracks_from_playlist, delete_playlist, update_playlist, sync_playlist_to_media_server
tools.player: Player: get_play_queue, edit_play_queue, play, now_playing, control_player, start_radio, get_lyrics, get_player_settings, set_player_settings, set_player_view
tools.operations: Operations (admin): get_download_queue_stats, pause_download_queue, resume_download_queue, list_jobs, trigger_job, get_system_health, get_maintenance_status, review_imports, check_for_updates, and read server logs for diagnostics (list_log_files, read_logs)

libraryNaming.rules: The template has to end in .{ext}. A token on its own is required: a track that cannot fill it is left alone, and a download that cannot fill it fails to import.

tokens.albumartist: The artist the album is filed under
tokens.artist: The artist credited on the track
tokens.title: Track title
tokens.disc: Disc number, empty unless the album has more than one
tokens.disc_total: How many discs the album has

problem.CONTROL_CHARACTER: The template carries a character that cannot appear in a filename.
problem.UNBALANCED_GROUP: Every < needs a > to close it.
problem.EMPTY_GROUP: Something between < and > has no token in it, so it can never disappear.
problem.SEPARATOR_IN_GROUP: Something between < and > covers a folder separator. Put the / outside it.
problem.ABSOLUTE_PATH: The template is relative to your library folder, so it cannot start with /.
problem.EMPTY_SEGMENT: There is a folder with nothing in its name.
problem.MISSING_EXTENSION: The template has to end in .{ext}, or nothing will play the file.
problem.EXTENSION_NOT_LAST: The file extension is added at the end on its own. Take it out of the middle.
problem.LITERAL_EXTENSION: This ends in a typed-out extension, and the real one goes after it. Take it out.
problem.EMPTY_FILENAME: The last part names the file, and this one leaves it blank.
problem.TRAILING_DOT: A name cannot end in a dot. The file extension goes right after it.
problem.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: There is a token here that does not exist. The ones that do are listed above.
problem.UNRENDERABLE: This template cannot produce a usable path.

tokensModal.title: Track Format Builder
tokensModal.ruleClick: Click a piece to drop it in where the cursor is.
tokensModal.rulePadding: The 02d on a number pads it to two digits, so track 1 files as 01 and your songs stay in order.
tokensModal.ruleBrackets: Wrapping a piece in < > makes it optional: if the song has nothing for it, that whole bit disappears. That is why <Disc {disc:02d}> is wrapped, since without it every album with a single disc would be left unfiled.
tokensModal.ruleOptional: A piece left outside the < > is required, and a song that cannot fill it stays where it is rather than being filed under a name with a gap in it.

duplicates.tidyAllBusy: The library is busy, this will keep until it finishes
duplicates.emptyBody: Every track in your library is held exactly once.
duplicates.reviewNote: Something about these copies could not be proven the same recording. Open a track and decide copy by copy.
duplicates.servedFileMissing: The file this track played is gone, so it will not play until you pick one below

reason.titles_differ: The copies carry different titles, so one may be a live take, a remix or another version. Resolving automatically could recycle a recording you cannot get back.
reason.untitled_copy: At least one copy has no title tag, so nothing can vouch for it being the same recording. Decide this one copy by copy.
reason.lengths_differ: The titles match but the copies do not last the same, so one is likely an edit, an extended cut or a different take. Resolving automatically could recycle a recording you cannot get back.
reason.length_unknown: One copy has not been measured yet, so nothing can vouch for it being the same recording. The next library scan will measure it.
reason.different_paths: The copies are in different library paths, so each may be there on purpose. Pick the one to keep with Keep this copy.

downloads_unwritable.title: Downloads folder is not writable
downloads_unwritable.effect: Downloads are on hold until Synthseek can write to {{path}}.
downloads_unwritable.fix: Give the user Synthseek runs as ownership of that folder on the host, for example: chown -R {{puid}}:{{pgid}} <your downloads folder>

library_inaccessible.title: A library path cannot be reached
library_inaccessible.effect: Music meant for {{label}} waits, and its files cannot be played, until {{path}} can be reached again.
library_inaccessible.fix: Check that the drive or share is mounted and that the user Synthseek runs as can read it, for example: chown -R {{puid}}:{{pgid}} <your music folder>

library_read_only.title: A library path is read-only
library_read_only.effect: Browsing and playback work, but new music for {{label}} cannot be added to {{path}}.
library_read_only.fix: If you want Synthseek to add music, give it write access, for example: chown -R {{puid}}:{{pgid}} <your music folder>

catalog_unreachable.title: Music catalog is not answering
catalog_unreachable.effect: Search and new requests fail until it answers again. Your library and playback keep working.
catalog_unreachable.fix: Check that this server can reach the internet. Synthseek checks again every minute.

config_value_ignored.title: A setting was ignored
config_value_ignored.effect: {{name}} holds an invalid value, so Synthseek started without it.
config_value_ignored.fix: Correct it or remove it from the container environment, then restart.
